prompt_payload.task: Generate a small portfolio of executable cross-domain optimization skills. A skill may reshape the GP kernel and may add a source-neighbor prior only when leave-one-out target calibration supports it.

target_schema.boundary: Only public feature schema is exposed. No target outcomes are included.

transfer_card.evidence_summary: Compiled 7 active role transfers from real_moleculenet_freesolv using 96 observed source rows and 16 conservative shared-vocabulary value priors. Direction is not transferred as a raw chemical rule; the card transfers role-level evidence strength and only transfers source value priors when source and target fields share the same public descriptor vocabulary.

base_policy.name: mixed_kernel_gp_ucb
base_policy.normalization: categorical weights are normalized to mean 1
base_policy.ensemble: multiple scales are aggregated by mean normalized candidate rank
base_policy.source_prior: mapped-role nearest-neighbor prediction from source observations; sign and strength are recalibrated using only currently revealed target observations

design_rules: Return diverse executable patches, not candidate IDs and not review prose.
At least one patch should include scale 0 as a target-only safety anchor in an ensemble.
At least one patch should focus on the two highest-confidence roles.
Include an exploration-first patch with gp_beta above 2.2 and gp_beta_end at or below 1.2.
Include a conservative patch with gp_beta and gp_beta_end both at or below 1.5.
Make at least one patch test a counter-hypothesis rather than only reinforcing the strongest source role.
Include at least two source-prior patches when mapped roles have shared vocabularies.
Use signed calibration when source and target objectives can be inversely related.
Use positive_only calibration only when the objective semantics support the same direction.
Set source_prior_strength to 0 when role vocabularies are not meaningfully comparable.
Downweight weak or semantically uncertain role mappings instead of treating all roles equally.
Use multi-scale ensembles when transfer strength is uncertain.
Do not claim access to target outcomes. Calibration and held-out evaluation happen after generation.

allowed_space.role_multipliers: map every target decision field to [0.20, 3.0]
allowed_space.gp_beta: number in [0.5, 3.0] used at the first replay round
allowed_space.gp_beta_end: number in [0.5, 3.0] reached linearly at the final replay round

patches.confidence: evidence-calibrated number in [0, 1]; do not reuse one default
patches.reason: brief hypothesis, counter-hypothesis, mechanism, and failure trigger

patches.reason: Target-only scale 0 anchors a rank ensemble while moderate scales test transferable role relevance; weak aromatic and ring evidence is downweighted, and failure is indicated if transferred scales consistently rank below the anchor.

Concentrates kernel similarity on hetero-atom and length, the two highest-confidence roles; reject the hypothesis if narrower role weighting hurts replay performance relative to broader or zero-scale members.

High initial GP-UCB exploration limits premature transfer lock-in, then anneals toward exploitation across an especially broad scale ensemble; fail when high-beta rounds consume budget without improving coverage or held-out gain.
Low-beta, low-scale ensemble makes only cautious evidence-weighted kernel changes and retains a target-only member; disable transfer if even small scales fail to beat the anchor.

Shared descriptor vocabularies justify testing a local mapped-neighbor prior, while signed calibration allows hydration and lipophilicity relationships to invert; set the prior contribution effectively to zero unless leave-one-out target gain clears the threshold.

Tests a smoother, higher-neighbor source prior to reduce variance from only 96 source rows, with a strict calibration gate guarding cross-objective bias; failure occurs when leave-one-out gain is unstable or below 0.12.

Counter-hypothesis: lipophilicity may depend more on halogenation and molecular structure than the source-leading hetero and length roles; abandon if structural emphasis underperforms the scale-0 anchor after calibration replay.

Aggressively tests only very close source neighbors in the best-supported shared roles, but the high leave-one-out gate prevents brittle sparse-prior transfer; failure is any gain below 0.20 or unstable fitted sign, which turns off the prior.
